source: DUPLO system dimensions: 2x2 brick footprint 31.8 mm (2 x 15.9 mm pitch), brick height 19.2 mm
studs_note: DUPLO is LEGO scaled by 2 in every dimension: LEGO stud 4.8 mm across and about 1.7 mm high, pitch 8 mm (DUPLO 16 mm; the footprint is 0.2 mm under the grid)

spot_search.note: candidate inspection spots: polar grid around the pan axis inside the hover reach (160-240 mm measured with kin.ik)

fit_min_iou_note: a footprint is accepted when the box model explains the brick's silhouette with IoU >= 0.8; a merged, occluded or mis-segmented blob scores lower (acceptance level, checked on recorded hovers)
